paragraphs.text: translated by
1. MAY Agni, Indra, Mitra, Varuna consent, Aryaman, Vayu, Pusan, and Sarasvati,
paragraphs.original: अग्निरिन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा वायुः पूषा सरस्वती सजोषसः ।
paragraphs.translit: agnirindro varuṇo mitro aryamā vāyuḥ pūṣā sarasvatī sajoṣasaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Adityas, Maruts, Visnu, Soma, lofty Sky, Rudra and Aditi, and Brahmanaspati.
paragraphs.original: आदित्या विष्णुर्मरुतः स्वर्बृहत्सोमो रुद्रो अदितिर्ब्रह्मणस्पतिः
paragraphs.translit: ādityā viṣṇurmarutaḥ svarbṛhatsomo rudro aditirbrahmaṇaspatiḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Indra and Agni, Hero-lords when Vrtra fell, dwelling together, speeding emulously on,
paragraphs.original: इन्द्राग्नी वृत्रहत्येषु सत्पती मिथो हिन्वाना तन्वा समोकसा ।
paragraphs.translit: indrāgnī vṛtrahatyeṣu satpatī mitho hinvānā tanvā samokasā |

paragraphs.text: And Soma blent with oil, putting his greatness forth, have with their power filled full the mighty firmament.
paragraphs.original: अन्तरिक्षं मह्या पप्रुरोजसा सोमो घृतश्रीर्महिमानमीरयन्
paragraphs.translit: antarikṣaṃ mahyā paprurojasā somo ghṛtaśrīrmahimānamīrayan

paragraphs.text: 3. Skilled in the Law I lift the hymn of praise to these, Law-strengtheners, unassailed, and great in majesty.
paragraphs.original: तेषां हि मह्ना महतामनर्वणां स्तोमाँ इयर्म्यृतज्ञा ऋतावृधाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: teṣāṃ hi mahnā mahatāmanarvaṇāṃ stomām̐ iyarmyṛtajñā ṛtāvṛdhām |

paragraphs.text: These in their wondrous bounty send the watery sea: may they as kindly Friends send gifts to make us great.
paragraphs.original: ये अप्सवमर्णवं चित्रराधसस्ते नो रासन्तां महये सुमित्र्याः
paragraphs.translit: ye apsavamarṇavaṃ citrarādhasaste no rāsantāṃ mahaye sumitryāḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. They with their might have stayed Heaven, Earth, and Prthivi, the Lord of Light, the firmament, -the lustrous spheres.
paragraphs.original: स्वर्णरमन्तरिक्षाणि रोचना द्यावाभूमी पृथिवीं स्कम्भुरोजसा ।
paragraphs.translit: svarṇaramantarikṣāṇi rocanā dyāvābhūmī pṛthivīṃ skambhurojasā |

paragraphs.text: Even as fleet-foot steeds who make their masters glad, the princely Gods are praised, most bountiful to man.
paragraphs.original: पृक्षा इव महयन्तः सुरातयो देवा स्तवन्ते मनुषाय सूरयः
paragraphs.translit: pṛkṣā iva mahayantaḥ surātayo devā stavante manuṣāya sūrayaḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Bring gifts to Mitra and to Varuna who, Lords of all, in spirit never fail the worshipper,
paragraphs.original: मित्राय शिक्ष वरुणाय दाशुषे या सम्राजा मनसा न प्रयुच्छतः ।
paragraphs.translit: mitrāya śikṣa varuṇāya dāśuṣe yā samrājā manasā na prayucchataḥ |

paragraphs.text: Whose statute shines on high through everlasting Law, whose places of sure refuge are the heavens and earth.
paragraphs.original: ययोर्धाम धर्मणा रोचते बृहद्ययोरुभे रोदसी नाधसी वृतौ
paragraphs.translit: yayordhāma dharmaṇā rocate bṛhadyayorubhe rodasī nādhasī vṛtau

paragraphs.text: 6. The cow who yielding milk goes her appointed way hither to us as leader of holy rites,
paragraphs.original: या गौर्वर्तनिं पर्येति निष्कृतं पयो दुहाना व्रतनीरवारतः ।
paragraphs.translit: yā gaurvartaniṃ paryeti niṣkṛtaṃ payo duhānā vratanīravārataḥ |

paragraphs.text: Speaking aloud to Varuna and the worshipper, shall with oblation serve Vivasvan and the Gods.
paragraphs.original: सा प्रब्रुवाणा वरुणाय दाशुषे देवेभ्यो दाशद्धविषा विवस्वते
paragraphs.translit: sā prabruvāṇā varuṇāya dāśuṣe devebhyo dāśaddhaviṣā vivasvate

paragraphs.text: 7. The Gods whose tongue is Agni dwell in heaven, and sit, aiders of Law, reflecting, in the seat of Law.
paragraphs.original: दिवक्षसो अग्निजिह्वा ऋतावृध ऋतस्य योनिं विमृशन्त आसते ।
paragraphs.translit: divakṣaso agnijihvā ṛtāvṛdha ṛtasya yoniṃ vimṛśanta āsate |

paragraphs.text: They propped up heaven and then brought waters with their might, got sacrifice and in a body made it fair.
paragraphs.original: द्यां स्कभित्व्यप आ चक्रुरोजसा यज्ञं जनित्वी तन्वी नि मामृजुः
paragraphs.translit: dyāṃ skabhitvyapa ā cakrurojasā yajñaṃ janitvī tanvī ni māmṛjuḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. Born in the oldest time, the Parents dwelling round are sharers of one mansion in the home of Law.
paragraphs.original: परिक्षिता पितरा पूर्वजावरी ऋतस्य योना क्षयतः समोकसा ।
paragraphs.translit: parikṣitā pitarā pūrvajāvarī ṛtasya yonā kṣayataḥ samokasā |

paragraphs.text: Bound by their common vow Dyaus, Prthivi stream forth the moisture rich in oil to Varuna the Steer.
paragraphs.original: द्यावापृथिवी वरुणाय सव्रते घृतवत्पयो महिषाय पिन्वतः
paragraphs.translit: dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇāya savrate ghṛtavatpayo mahiṣāya pinvataḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. Parjanya, Vata, mighty, senders of the rain, Indra and Vayu, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman:
paragraphs.original: पर्जन्यावाता वृषभा पुरीषिणेन्द्रवायू वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
paragraphs.translit: parjanyāvātā vṛṣabhā purīṣiṇendravāyū varuṇo mitro aryamā |

paragraphs.text: We call on Aditi, Adityas, and the Gods, those who are on the earth, in waters, and in heaven.
paragraphs.original: देवाँ आदित्याँ अदितिं हवामहे ये पार्थिवासो दिव्यासो अप्सु ये
paragraphs.translit: devām̐ ādityām̐ aditiṃ havāmahe ye pārthivāso divyāso apsu ye

paragraphs.text: 10. Tvastar and Vayu, those who count as Rbhus, both celestial Hotar-priests, and Dawn for happiness,
paragraphs.original: त्वष्टारं वायुमृभवो य ओहते दैव्या होतारा उषसं स्वस्तये ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṣṭāraṃ vāyumṛbhavo ya ohate daivyā hotārā uṣasaṃ svastaye |

paragraphs.text: Winners of wealth, we call, and wise Brhaspati, destroyer of our foes, and Soma Indra's Friend.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिं वृत्रखादं सुमेधसमिन्द्रियं सोमं धनसा उ ईमहे
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatiṃ vṛtrakhādaṃ sumedhasamindriyaṃ somaṃ dhanasā u īmahe

paragraphs.text: 11. They generated prayer, the cow, the horse, the plants, the forest trees, the earth, the waters, and the hills.
paragraphs.original: ब्रह्म गामश्वं जनयन्त ओषधीर्वनस्पतीन्पृथिवीं पर्वताँ अपः ।
paragraphs.translit: brahma gāmaśvaṃ janayanta oṣadhīrvanaspatīnpṛthivīṃ parvatām̐ apaḥ |

paragraphs.text: These very bounteous Gods made the Sun mount to heaven, and spread the righteous laws of Aryas o'er the land.
paragraphs.original: सूर्यं दिवि रोहयन्तः सुदानव आर्या व्रता विसृजन्तो अधि क्षमि
paragraphs.translit: sūryaṃ divi rohayantaḥ sudānava āryā vratā visṛjanto adhi kṣami

paragraphs.text: 12. O Asvins, ye delivered Bhujyu from distress, ye animated Syava, Vadhrmati's son.
paragraphs.original: भुज्युमंहसः पिपृथो निरश्विना श्यावं पुत्रं वध्रिमत्या अजिन्वतम् ।
paragraphs.translit: bhujyumaṃhasaḥ pipṛtho niraśvinā śyāvaṃ putraṃ vadhrimatyā ajinvatam |

paragraphs.text: To Vimada ye brought his consort Kamadyu, and gave his lost Visnapu back to Visvaka.
paragraphs.original: कमद्युवं विमदायोहथुर्युवं विष्णाप्वं विश्वकायाव सृजथः
paragraphs.translit: kamadyuvaṃ vimadāyohathuryuvaṃ viṣṇāpvaṃ viśvakāyāva sṛjathaḥ

paragraphs.text: 13. Thunder, the lightning's daughter, Aja-Ekapad, heaven's bearer, Sindhu, and the waters of the sea:
paragraphs.original: पावीरवी तन्यतुरेकपादजो दिवो धर्ता सिन्धुरापः समुद्रियः ।
paragraphs.translit: pāvīravī tanyaturekapādajo divo dhartā sindhurāpaḥ samudriyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Hear all the Gods my words, Sarasvati give ear together with Purandhi and with Holy Thoughts.
paragraphs.original: विश्वे देवासः शृणवन्वचांसि मे सरस्वती सह धीभिः पुरंध्या
paragraphs.translit: viśve devāsaḥ śṛṇavanvacāṃsi me sarasvatī saha dhībhiḥ puraṃdhyā

paragraphs.text: 14. With Holy Thoughts and with Purandhi may all Gods, knowing the Law immortal, Manu's Holy Ones,
paragraphs.original: विश्वे देवाः सह धीभिः पुरंध्या मनोर्यजत्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
paragraphs.translit: viśve devāḥ saha dhībhiḥ puraṃdhyā manoryajatrā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Boon-givers, favourers, finders of light, and Heaven, with gracious love accept my songs, my prayer, my hymn.
paragraphs.original: रातिषाचो अभिषाचः स्वर्विदः स्वर्गिरो ब्रह्म सूक्तं जुषेरत
paragraphs.translit: rātiṣāco abhiṣācaḥ svarvidaḥ svargiro brahma sūktaṃ juṣerata

paragraphs.text: 15. Immortal Gods have I, Vasistha, lauded, Gods set on high above all other beings.
paragraphs.original: देवान्वसिष्ठो अमृतान्ववन्दे ये विश्वा भुवनाभि प्रतस्थुः ।
paragraphs.translit: devānvasiṣṭho amṛtānvavande ye viśvā bhuvanābhi pratasthuḥ |

paragraphs.text: May they this day grant us wide space and freedom: ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
paragraphs.original: ते नो रासन्तामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः
paragraphs.translit: te no rāsantāmurugāyamadya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
